info.title: Seereon HRMS API
info.description: REST API for the Seereon HRMS client build (single organisation, Group › Company › Branch). Every endpoint lists the frontend screens that call it (`x-screens`). Errors are RFC 7807 problem documents. Send `X-Company-Id` / `X-Branch-Id` to choose the working scope (Super Admin / Admin).
